# Oneed Research Institute

Official website: https://www.oneedinstitute.ca
Contact: info@oneedinstitute.ca
Phone: +1-226-753-2321

## About
Oneed Research Institute advances global education through research, innovation, and inclusion. We provide research support, training, conferences, grants and scholarship guidance, and academic services.
